import json,hashlib,zipfile,math
from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction
root=Path.cwd()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def read(n):return json.loads((root/n).read_bytes())
def archive_pair(before,after):
    assert sha(before['path'])==before['sha256'] and sha(after['path'])==after['sha256']
    with zipfile.ZipFile(before['path']) as a,zipfile.ZipFile(after['path']) as b:
        assert set(a.namelist())==set(b.namelist())
        for name in a.namelist():
            assert a.read(name)==b.read(name)
            if 'members' in before:assert hashlib.sha256(a.read(name)).hexdigest()==before['members'][name]
        return {'before_sha256':before['sha256'],'after_sha256':after['sha256'],'equal_members':len(a.namelist())}
s=read('joined_phi_u1_spatial_linked_corrected_weighted_20261010_receipt.json')
c=read('joined_phi_u1_spatial_linked_corrected_weighted_consumer_20261010_receipt.json')
assert s['source_inputs_unchanged']
archives=[archive_pair(s['preexecution'],s['executed']),archive_pair(c['preexecution'],c['executed'])]
sp=[]
for case in s['cases']:
    roles=case['charged_role_observations'];g=math.sqrt(case['frozen_G_display']['g0']);V=case['V']
    active,aux=map(lambda r:float(Fraction(r['onsite_exact'])),roles)
    w=[(1+math.cos(p)/4)**2/(33/32) for p in case['raw_cell_phi']]
    O=sum(-8*wi+2*ph for wi,ph in zip(w,case['raw_cell_PH_weighted_integrand']))/len(w)
    corrected=64*roles[0]['matter_energy']+63*(aux-active)*g*(V//4)*O
    assert abs(corrected-case['matter_energy'])<1e-7
    assert abs(corrected-64*roles[0]['matter_energy'])>1
    assert case['imposed_loop_delta_same_H']>0
    assert case['complete_H_variance_lower_bound']>0
    wrong=case['conditional_shared_overlap']['wrong_constant_overlap_repeated_weight']
    assert wrong>1e6 and abs(case['conditional_shared_overlap']['constant_overlap_weight_once']-1)<1e-12
    sp.append({'N':case['N'],'role_corrected_energy':case['complete_body_energy_relative_neutral_eigenenergy'],'A1_energy':case['same_H_A_equals_1_control']['complete_body_energy_relative_neutral_eigenenergy'],'imposed_same_H_cost':case['imposed_loop_delta_same_H'],'complete_variance_lower':case['complete_H_variance_lower_bound'],'mass_collapse_rejected':True,'both_nonstationary':True,'replica_overlap_witness_withdrawn':True})
